review.note: T143 N2 approved. tsc exit 0; vitest dragReorder (18) + motion pass. Pointer events only (onPointerDown/Move/Up/Cancel, setPointerCapture), no HTML5 draggable. drag-reorder.css: 2px var(--accent) drop line via ::after, no box-shadow, only transform transitions using --duration-fast/--ease-out, lifted row transition none, prefers-reduced-motion disables transitions. 5px threshold keeps short press a click and a real drag swallows the trailing click. Escape (capture keydown) and pointercancel cancel without reorder. Note: rows must be siblings under one parent and count must equal items.length, else drag silently does not start; N4 must honour that. Full npm test not run by reviewer (author saw one load timeout in document.test.ts, passes alone).

log.note: Created src/components/dragReorder.ts (pure: insertionIndex, reorder, clampOffset, shiftFor, dropEdge, DragController with threshold/cancel), useDragReorder.ts (hook), dragReorder.test.ts (18 tests), drag-reorder.css. Verified: tests failed first (module missing), then 18 pass; tsc 0; src/motion.test.ts passes with the new CSS; full npm test 1009/1010, sole failure src/export/document.test.ts PDF timeout 5s under load, passes alone (32/32). No Playwright/native run (N4 integrates). CLAIMED. API for N4: useDragReorder({items,onReorder(from,to),threshold=5}) returns {rowProps(index), dragging}. rowProps adds data-drag-index/data-drag-state(lifted|shifted)/data-drag-edge(top|bottom) beyond the plan's keys; rows MUST be siblings sharing one parent (hook measures parent's :scope > [data-drag-index], count must equal items.length, else no drag); spread rowProps last or merge style; import drag-reorder.css once. The click ending a real drag is swallowed. Escape/pointercancel cancels. Keyboard reorder stays with existing arrow buttons (hook adds none). Drop line is a ::after on the target row (no separate .drop-line element). DESIGN DOC: Drag to reorder -- pointer events with capture after 5 px travel (below that a press stays a click); the lifted row follows the pointer by transform: translateY, clamped to the list; siblings between source and target step aside by the lifted row's height (transform only, --duration-fast --ease-out); a 2 px --accent line on the target row's edge marks the landing slot; no shadow; Escape cancels; reduced motion removes the shift transition. Keyboard reordering stays on the move buttons. Files: src/components/dragReorder.ts: uncommitted edits
